Description:
💍❤️ Expanded Marriage Proposal Options is a game-changing content patcher mod for Stardew Valley. 🌾🥰 With this mod, players get access to tons of new dialogue options to express their love and commitment in a variety of heartfelt and creative ways. 🎁💕 Whether you're a male or female character, this mod puts you in control of your marriage proposal's emotional tone. You can choose to be humorous, romantic, or sentimental, depending on what you want to convey. 💬💝 The new dialogue options also give players a chance to dive deeper into their character's motivations and emotions, creating a more immersive and realistic gameplay experience.
 
Overall, this mod is a must-have for players looking to take their relationships to the next level and deepen their connections with NPC partners. 😍💑 With its expanded marriage proposal options, players can finally break away from the same old boring dialogue options and discover a new world of romantic opportunities in Stardew Valley. 🌟 So why wait? Download Expanded Marriage Proposal Options today and start planning the perfect proposal! 💖
